user_goal: Find a print product to order by browsing, filtering, sorting, or searching the catalog.
business_goal: Faster, more relevant product discovery drives add-to-cart and checkout conversion.

user_journey.step: Narrow to a category (either via the category-scoped route or the ?category= filter)
Refine with price/tag/badge filters and a sort order
user_journey.route_or_state: /products (query params: sort, min, max, tags, badge)

user_journey.step: Or bypass filters entirely with a text search
Scroll to load more results (infinite scroll)

happy_path.expected_result: Product grid renders; toolbar shows the real total count as "<N> products" (features/products/ProductsPageShell.tsx:159)

happy_path.action: Open the sort dropdown and choose a different sort order
happy_path.selector: button, initial text "Most Popular" (features/products/SortDropdown.tsx:27-40); menu item text from SORT_OPTIONS, e.g. "Price: Low to High"
happy_path.expected_result: URL's sort param updates and the grid re-fetches page 1 sorted accordingly

happy_path.action: Apply a category filter from the sidebar
happy_path.expected_result: Grid re-fetches scoped to the chosen category; category chip appears in ActiveFilters

happy_path.action: Scroll to the bottom sentinel to trigger infinite-scroll load-more
happy_path.selector: sentinelRef div (features/products/ProductsPageShell.tsx:207), visible only while hasMore is true
happy_path.expected_result: "Loading more…" spinner shows (ProductsPageShell.tsx:210), then additional products append to the grid without resetting scroll position

happy_path.action: Open a product from the grid
happy_path.selector: ProductCard root <Link> wrapping the product image/name (features/products/ProductCard.tsx:31)

alternate_paths.path_name: Category-scoped route instead of query param

steps.expected_result: Category filter is derived from the path segment; any stray ?category= query param is stripped rather than conflicting (features/products/useProductFilters.ts:24-46, CATEGORY_PATH_RE)

steps.action: Type 2+ characters into the search input
steps.expected_result: After a 400ms debounce (hooks/useDebounce.ts), results come from searchProductsPaged() (Typesense /search) instead of getProducts(); FilterControls and SortDropdown both render disabled with title="Sorting isn't available for search results" (SortDropdown.tsx:33), and a note explains category/price/tag filters aren't available while searching (ProductsPageShell.tsx:174-176)

alternate_paths.path_name: Clear an active filter via the chip

steps.action: Remove a filter from the ActiveFilters chip row
steps.selector: chip inside features/products/ActiveFilters.tsx (exact markup not read this pass)
steps.expected_result: Corresponding URL param is cleared and the grid re-fetches

error_paths.expected_ui_response: EmptyState with title "No products found" and description literally "No results for \"<term>\". Try a different search term." (features/products/ProductsPageShell.tsx:190-197)
EmptyState with title "No products found" and description "Try adjusting your filters or search for something else." (same component, non-search branch)

edge_cases.case: Scroll-triggered load-more firing again while a previous load is still in flight
edge_cases.risk_note: Validated in code — a real regression here would be a race that appends duplicate items, not a missing guard.

edge_cases.case: A filter/sort/search change arrives while a load-more request for the previous result set is still in flight
edge_cases.existing_validation: generationRef increments on every fresh products/total from the server; a load-more response captured against a stale generation is discarded instead of appended (features/products/ProductsPageShell.tsx:74-83, 97)
edge_cases.risk_note: Worth an explicit test: change the sort order immediately after triggering a load-more and confirm no stale-page duplicate/mismatched items appear.

edge_cases.case: Reaching the true end of results
edge_cases.existing_validation: hasMore is derived from items.length < total; UI shows "You've seen all <N> products." instead of the sentinel (ProductsPageShell.tsx:218-222)
edge_cases.risk_note: None identified — implemented and directly assertable, included for completeness rather than as a gap.

edge_cases.case: Rapid typing in the search box
edge_cases.risk_note: No client-side minimum-length guard visible in ProductsPageShell beyond the shared isSearching >= 2 chars convention in useProductFilters.ts — confirm the debounce alone doesn't fire a wasted 1-character query.

gaps: features/products/ActiveFilters.tsx's chip markup/selectors were not read this pass — needed before /qa:generate-tests can script alt-03 without letting the Playwright Generator agent discover it live.

Category names/slugs are seeded data from the backend, not present in source — hp-03's exact category selector is intentionally left null; the Generator agent should discover it from the live DOM rather than have one guessed here.

This plan only covers the storefront listing/search/browse surface. Add-to-cart, pricing-tier selection, and the product detail page itself are separate features (product detail page has its own configurator per features/products/configurator/) and were out of scope for this grounding pass.
